notes.title: 【盲盒福利】圣诞节&新年快乐
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38324303/46f13e5b6ca4c72f082d712ea717cb19022b079f.jpg[/img]

[h1]LSP祝您圣诞节日以及2025年新年快乐！[/h1]

[h3]☃️ LSP+1盲盒福利活动[/h3]

在圣诞和即将到来的2025年元旦，我们将举办“看板娘的圣诞袜”与“看板娘的新年福袋”活动！12月24日平安夜和明年1月1日的某一时刻，LSP+1兑换页面将出现消耗3次兑换资格的激活码盲盒。

盲盒中的礼物为随机中文恋爱游戏的Steam激活码1个。除了我们代理的作品补档外，还有首次登场的新作以及来自友商的热门作品掉落。在激活前，谁都不知道领取的是什么……

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38324303/e2f913f49ab85a6642ca3107a90b0f88e0f81ab9.png[/img]


[h3]参加活动[/h3]
“看板娘的圣诞袜”将在平安夜出现，消耗3次兑换次数即可领取盲盒CDKEY一个【🔗[url=https://www.lspsp.me/bonus]前往领取[/url] 】


[hr][/hr]
*活动最终解释权LSP所有。感谢琉璃花糖制作组、风域游戏、Never Knows Best制作组、Nekoday、橘子班、零创游戏(ZerocreationGame)、埋月山枯、KIDFansClub、昆布科技、Fontainebleau对活动的支持。

notes.title: Winter Sale Kickoff & New Event Preview
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44087593/cad70404dc1412e504ed29e03142478a5c740ebf.jpg[/img]  
[h3]The heartwarming "Steam Winter Sale" is officially here~! We've brought you year-end discounts across all titles and previews of new activities. Come and check it out——[/h3]  

[h2]❄️ LSP Winter Sale[/h2]  
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44087593/d3232c503db62198b6320a4694b01336085df636.png[/img]  
[b]Explosive discounts spanning Christmas and New Year![/b]  
From December 20 to January 3, you can enjoy special prices on the LSP dating game series. The youth campus romance prose poem *The Roc - 大鹏*, which has received a "Very Positive" rating (50.94%), is now available at a historical low price of 20% off, just ¥19.2!  
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44087593/4ab85a407ffc4117c6c4a596c1adc2832dea1066.png[/img]  
❙ Go to the sale venue: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/LSPGAL/list/137689]https://store.steampowered.com/developer/LSPGAL/list/137689[/url]  

[h2]⛄ Limited-Time Bundles[/h2]  

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44087593/ee52910706db5efaf9692e977cbb67893944d127.jpg[/img]  
The flower of yuri blooms in shadows—introducing the "LSP Dark Yuri Bundle," available for a limited time. This bundle includes two dark-themed yuri works. During the Winter Sale, get both *The Street of Adrift* and *Dreamless Girl* with a 17% discount. With the sale's additional promotion, you can grab both 2023 releases for just ¥45.  

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48575/LSP_Dark_Yuri_Bundle/  

[h2]🎅 [New Event] Game Redemption Qualifications Giveaway[/h2]  

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44087593/a1dca6f07d24fbfdf3b21d594b8928f578d15a81.jpg[/img]  
On December 24 and January 1, we will hold the "Christmas Stockings of the Mascot" and "New Year Lucky Bags of the Mascot" events. During the event, a blind box requiring 3 redemption qualifications will appear at the top of the LSP+1 redemption page. [b]Contents of the blind box are currently confidential. Stay tuned![/b]  

To prepare, we’ve urgently launched a lottery where you can earn redemption qualifications. Join the LSP Lottery now for a chance to win 0–2 redemption qualifications! Users with V3 or above can also participate in a special lottery with a 100% chance of winning at least 1 qualification. You can earn up to 3 qualifications—don't miss out!  

❙ Go to the LSP Lottery: [url=https://www.lspsp.me/lottery]https://www.lspsp.me/lottery[/url]  

[h3]Happy shopping, enjoy your games, and may good luck always be with you![/h3]
